questions.question: If the nine-digit number 3422213AB is divisible by 99, then what is the value of 2A + B?
questions.questionHtml: If the nine-digit number 3422213AB is divisible by 99, then what is the value of 2A + B?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Number 3422213AB is divisible by 99, so it must be divisible by 9 and 11.

For divisibility by 9: Sum of digits (3+4+2+2+2+1+3+A+B) = 17 + A + B must be a multiple of 9.

For divisibility by 11: (B + 3 + 2 + 2 + 3) − (A + 1 + 2 + 4) = (10 + B) − (7 + A) = 3 + B − A must be 0 or 11.

Solving these: If 3 + B − A = 0 ⇒ A − B = 3. Substituting in 17 + A + B = 27 ⇒ A + B = 10. Solving gives A = 6.5 (not possible).

If 17 + A + B = 18 ⇒ A + B = 1. Then 3 + B − A = 0 ⇒ A − B = 3 (not possible). If 17 + A + B = 27 ⇒ A + B = 10 and 3 + B − A = 11 ⇒ B − A = 8. Then 2B = 18 ⇒ B = 9, A = 1.

Calculation: 2A + B = 2(1) + 9 = 11.

∴ The correct answer is 11.

Alternate Method

Given: Number 3422213AB is divisible by 99.

Divisibility Rules: 99 = 9 × 11. The number must satisfy both rules.

⇒ Sum of digits = 3 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 3 + A + B = 17 + A + B

⇒ For div. by 9, 17 + A + B = 18 or 27 ⇒ A + B = 1 or A + B = 10

⇒ For div. by 11, (B + 3 + 2 + 2 + 3) − (A + 1 + 2 + 4) = (10 + B) − (7 + A) = 3 + B − A

⇒ 3 + B − A must be 0 or 11 ⇒ A − B = 3 or B − A = 8

⇒ Case 1: A + B = 10 and B − A = 8 ⇒ 2B = 18 ⇒ B = 9 and A = 1

⇒ Required value: 2A + B = 2(1) + 9 = 2 + 9 = 11

∴ The correct answer is 11.

Additional Information

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 9.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Composite Divisibility

If a number is divisible by coprime factors x and y, then it is divisible by their product (x × y).

Within an hour, he was in jail. Q. He made no attempts to hide his identity and even looked directly into the security camera and smiled. R. On Jan 6, 1995, McArthur Wheeler boldly robbed two banks in broad daylight with no disguise. S. By 11:00 at night, his picture was all over the news, leading an informant to identify Wheeler to the police.
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. Within an hour, he was in jail.

Q. He made no attempts to hide his identity and even looked directly into the security camera and smiled.

R. On Jan 6, 1995, McArthur Wheeler boldly robbed two banks in broad daylight with no disguise.

S. By 11:00 at night, his picture was all over the news, leading an informant to identify Wheeler to the police.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: RQSP. The paragraph begins with (R), which introduces the subject (McArthur Wheeler) and the specific event (robbing two banks on a specific date). Sentence (Q) follows by describing his behavior during the robbery (no disguise, smiling at cameras). Sentence (S) provides the chronological consequence of his actions being caught on camera (his picture on the news by 11:00 PM and identification by an informant). Finally, (P) concludes the sequence by stating he was in jail within an hour of being identified.
